sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Premium Sign Supplies is a full-service sign supply distributor offering vinyl films, digital media, printing equipment, and signage materials.

Industry: Sign Manufacturing & Supply · HQ: Pennsylvania, United States · Size: <$50M · Products: Roland printers and cutters, Avery vinyl films, Arlon print media, GFP laminators, Heat presses, Reflective films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Premium Sign Supplies, Inc. scores 32 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (28/30). Nothing was found for application fit, event engagement and pain-point alignment, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: No durability claims were found in their public copy, so the opening has to establish the problem before the product. Lead with the cost of premature graphic failure rather than with film chemistry.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (54% similar on films, vinyl, media, digital); Drytac (39% similar on media, films, vinyl, sign); Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (38% similar on films, vinyl, digital, graphics). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Event engagement: Confirming attendance at one more show would add points.
• Pain-point alignment: Each additional durability theme found adds 5 points.
• Flags on the record: size third party estimate
